$comment: GalyVverse connections registry. Links this repository's skills and integrations to the Manus email channels. NO email addresses, tokens, or credentials belong in this file — all addresses and SMTP credentials are provided at runtime via GitHub Actions secrets / environment variables referenced by name below.

repository.name: Twin-Flame
repository.role: repo-creation hub and Copilot/Manus task bridge

manusWorkflowEmail.description: Manus workflow email. Receives operational notifications: repo-creation results, CI/workflow status, and integration events. Address is never committed; it is resolved at runtime from the MANUS_WORKFLOW_EMAIL secret.

manusTaskbotEmail.description: Manus taskbot email (your personalized Manus task-intake address from Manus settings). Receives actionable task requests: emails sent here create tasks in Manus. Address is never committed; it is resolved at runtime from the MANUS_TASKBOT_EMAIL secret.

integrations.description: JSON-driven repo creation for the GalyVverse org (hub.config.json, scripts/create-repo.js, .github/workflows/create-repo.yml).

channelRouting.manusWorkflowEmail: optional non-blocking notification when a repository is created

integrations.description: GitHub Copilot coding-agent tasks in this repository. Issues opened or assigned in this hub are forwarded as task emails so Manus can pick them up.

channelRouting.manusWorkflowEmail: copy for visibility when channel is 'both'
channelRouting.manusTaskbotEmail: primary: actionable task creation in Manus

integrations.description: Manus task intake via email. Sending a message to the personalized Manus task email creates a task; the workflow email receives status/notification copies.

Anchor Browser agent access (see integration-notes.md). Server-side credential only; issued key is sent solely in the provider-designated API-key header and is never exposed to clients, logs, or this file.

Firecrawl integration (see integration-notes.md). Uses a protected server-side FIRECRAWL_API_KEY; remains credential-gated until PKCE authorization completes. Keyless fallback is rate-limited and explicitly marked as limited access.
